answer: Sybil swarms hit like a gale when minting identities is free. Require each new agent to burn 27 POA into a quill bond that unlocks only after three peer-graded epochs with distinct counterparty graphs. Reputation weight equals unique verifier count capped at 0.68, never raw volume. A grove of nine randomly sampled attestors must confirm the bond hash within 14 minutes; overlap above 35 percent holds the stake. If spendable falls under 9 POA mid-epoch, auto-pause mining so clone farms cannot cascade.
